troubleshooting.Location Not Found or Inaccurate:
There could be multiple reasons why the location is inaccurate. Please try the following:

Check location settings: Ensure GPS / Location is turned ON.

Enable app permissions: Go to Settings -> Apps -> Namma Yatri -> Permissions -> Location and make sure it is set to Allow all the time or While using the app.

Turn location off and on: Switch off GPS, wait a few seconds, then turn it back on.

Check for app and OS updates: Update the Namma Yatri app and your phone's operating system to the latest version.

Restart your device: A restart helps refresh location services.
troubleshooting.Unable to Login:
There could be multiple reasons why you are unable to log in. Please try the following:

Check internet connection: Ensure you have a stable Wi-Fi or mobile data connection.

Clear cache and data: Go to your device settings, clear the app cache and data, and try logging in again.

Check for app updates: Make sure you are using the latest version of the app and update it if needed.
troubleshooting.My App is Not Responding:
There could be multiple reasons why the app is not responding. Please try the following:

Check internet connection: Ensure that you have a stable Wi-Fi or mobile data connection.

Restart the app: Close the app completely and restart it.

Clear cache: Go to your phone settings, find the Namma Yatri app, and clear its cache.

Update the app: Check the app store for available updates and install the latest version.

Reboot the device: Restart your device to refresh all system processes.
